elitetensura.skill.ancient_soul.descript: A primordial soul that resonates with nearby life. While toggled on, grants the holder and nearby allies Strength III, Regeneration III, and Resistance I, while Soul Sight outlines surrounding creatures by alignment — red for enemies, green for allies, cyan for the unaffiliated. Drains a trickle of magicule while active.
elitetensura.skill.basiliskskin_ultimate: Transforms your skin into one of a Basilisk scales which become tougher as you gain more EP(Cap however easter egg)
elitetensura.skill.beelzebuth.descriptio: The insatiable Ultimate evolved from Gluttony at the cost of Merciless. Devour, store, convert, and redistribute power through the Food Chain.
elitetensura.skill.brain.description: A unique skill that cannot be obtained through normal means.
elitetensura.skill.crocodile_skin.descri: Transforms your skin into one of crocodile scales which become tougher as you gain more EP (Has a Cap)
elitetensura.skill.dimensionless.descrip: The ultimate skill of Noir, Lord of Nothingness. A being who erased their own existence from reality and became one with the void between dimensions. Those who wield this power stand outside the laws of the world itself.
elitetensura.skill.elder_soul.descriptio: A primordial soul in full bloom. A 40-block aura grants allies Strength III, Regeneration III and Resistance II, Soul Sight reaches further — and every enemy inside the aura is outlined for all your allies to see.

elitetensura.skill.fortunes_eye.descript: A scavenger's instinct honed into true sight. Permanent Luck III (Luck IV mastered), and Loot Sense reveals every dropped item nearby with a golden outline.
elitetensura.skill.gaia.description: The land itself answers. Raise the earth to impale and to bind, reshape the ground your people hold, coax ore from bare stone, and draw the world's own magicule into yourself. Strongest where your nation's banner flies.
elitetensura.skill.gravity_well.descript: Gravity magic. Hold to warp space at the point you are aiming at, then release to collapse it into a crushing sphere that drags everything inside toward its centre, deals a fraction of each victim's max health every second, and smothers flight and dash escapes. When mastered, hold past the cast time to charge a wider, longer, harder-crushing well. Requires Burden mastered to learn.
elitetensura.skill.greatapetransformatio: The way of transformation at will, become strong as a Gaint Ape also know as Oozaru Transformation
elitetensura.skill.hecate.description: The goddess of magic. While held, the magicule cost of nearly every spell is floored to its minimum (Reincarnation excluded). Toggle on for chant annulment, thought acceleration, +1 learning & mastery, and bonus damage with all spells.
elitetensura.skill.hephaestus.descriptio: The forge answers its lord. Repair and reforge what exists, engrave it, conjure arms from nothing, sense the ore beneath stone, and turn a smith's mastery into a weapon.
elitetensura.skill.iron_resolve.descript: A unique skill born from an unbreakable will to endure. The holder bends hardship into strength, refusing to be undone by the world around them.
elitetensura.skill.iron_resolve.last_sta: Last Stand has activated — resolve holds.
elitetensura.skill.kaioken.description: A body-burning Saiyan battle-aura. Multiply your power far past its limit in a crimson blaze — the higher the multiplier, the fiercer the strain on your body. Stronger tiers unlock as your EP grows and the technique is mastered.
elitetensura.skill.kaioken.exhausted: Your body is still wracked from Kaioken — you can't ignite it again yet.
elitetensura.skill.kamehameha.descriptio: Energy magic. Hold to gather magicule into a glowing sphere, then release to fire a sustained blue-white energy wave that tracks your aim, searing everything in its path and exploding against terrain. When mastered, hold past the cast time to charge a wider, far more destructive wave.
elitetensura.skill.kami.description: How did you get this skill? Report it to an AdminPlease
elitetensura.skill.mechanical_eyes.descr: When toggled on, this skill grants you unparalleled insight into intricate mechanisms.
elitetensura.skill.mechanical_hands.desc: When activated, this skill grants you unmatched precision in manipulating complex machinery, allowing you to effortlessly rotate or disassemble mechanical structures with ease.
elitetensura.skill.mechanical_hands.no_t: Mechanical Hands: No valid target or action!
elitetensura.skill.mechanical_hands.not_: Mechanical Hands: This block is not wrenchable.
elitetensura.skill.meditation.descriptio: Helps regenerate Aura, Magic, and SHP faster when toggled
elitetensura.skill.mode.dimensionless.di: A vault carved into the space between worlds by Noir's hand. No force in existence can reach what is stored within the abyss.
elitetensura.skill.mode.dimensionless.ex: Channel Noir's most feared ability — partially erase the existence of all nearby enemies. Their buffs dissolve, their bodies weaken, and a fragment of their being is consumed by the void.
elitetensura.skill.mode.dimensionless.ph: Tear through dimensional space with Noir's full authority, leaving nothing but a void echo where you once stood. Twice the range, half the effort.
elitetensura.skill.mode.dimensionless.vo: Ascend beyond the boundaries of existence as Noir once did. Each use draws you closer to the void, permanently accumulating its power within your soul. At ten stacks, you become one with nothingness.
Fragments of Noir's power permanently fused to your soul through Void Ascension. At maximum stacks, the boundary between yourself and the void ceases to exist.
elitetensura.skill.mode.iron_resolve.iro: Channel your energy into a defensive field. The more EP you hold, the greater the damage you can absorb before it reaches your body. Lasts 20 seconds. Mastered: can be toggled on permanently.
elitetensura.skill.mode.iron_resolve.las: When enabled, automatically reacts if your HP is brought below 40%: cleanses all debuffs, grants debuff immunity for 3 minutes, and triggers Resolute Surge. Has a long internal cooldown.
elitetensura.skill.mode.iron_resolve.res: Pour your will into raw offensive power, granting Strength III for 5 minutes. Mastered: lasts 10 minutes.
elitetensura.skill.mode.iron_resolve.vei: Attune your focus to the earth, granting extreme Haste for 20 seconds. Mastered: can be toggled on permanently.
elitetensura.skill.mode.void_edge.descri: Hurl a blade of unstable void energy at your target. It cuts through mundane defences, though its power pales against what this skill could one day become.
elitetensura.skill.mode.void_walker.dime: Access a hidden inventory that exists outside normal space, carved from the void itself.
elitetensura.skill.mode.void_walker.null: Channel Noir's essence to create a zone of absolute nothingness, suppressing magic and crippling all nearby enemies.
elitetensura.skill.mode.void_walker.phas: Blink forward through space, briefly phasing through blocks. A fragment of Noir's boundless movement.
elitetensura.skill.mode.voidedge.void_cl: Wrap yourself in a thin veil of void energy, suppressing your presence and sharpening your evasion. Drains aura while active.
elitetensura.skill.mode.voidsovereign.ev: Collapse space between yourself and your destination, tearing through every entity in your path and marking them with void energy.
elitetensura.skill.mode.voidsovereign.la: Void Domain has collapsed — insufficient aura to sustain it.
elitetensura.skill.mode.voidsovereign.nu: Launch a blade of severance energy that erases what it touches, leaving targets weakened and their defenses stripped.
elitetensura.skill.mode.voidsovereign.so: Channel void energy into a focused spiritual burst. The longer you hold, the deeper the wound — striking directly at the soul.
elitetensura.skill.mode.voidsovereign.vo: Activate a field of suppressive will around yourself, concealing your presence and empowering your strikes with spiritual force. Drains aura over time.
elitetensura.skill.occultist_skill_uniqu: Use the power of souls to change the world
elitetensura.skill.ouroboros.description: The serpent that devours its own tail. Feed on the fight, strike across seconds, shed what wounds you, rewind your missteps, complete death rather than avoid it, and devour what stands before you.

elitetensura.skill.raphealskill.descript: The Voice of the World given form — a battlefield-computation entity. Analysis unlocks everything: prediction, barriers, reverse-engineering, and Raphael's own counsel.
elitetensura.skill.raphealskill.emergenc: Report. Lethal damage predicted — emergency defense executed autonomously.
Subject %1$s not yet analyzed. Analysis required before reconstruction.
elitetensura.skill.runesmiths_insight.de: Hard-won intuition at the forge. Passively widens the hammer sweet spot and slows temperature drift during forge minigames. When mastered, each forged item has a chance to gain an extra enhancement slot. Learned automatically through repeated successful forging.
elitetensura.skill.scavenger.description: A keen eye for treasure. Passively grants Luck II, improving loot from chests, mob drops, and mining. Mastery unlocks a toggle that upgrades the buff to Luck III.
elitetensura.skill.scavenger.toggled_on: Scavenger activated — Luck III is now active.
elitetensura.skill.ssj1.description_skil: &cTransform into a Super Saiyan..? I wonder what it does to me.
elitetensura.skill.static_chain.descript: Lightning magic. Loose an arc at the target you are looking at; it leaps to nearby foes, dealing less damage with each jump and leaving them Glowing and slowed. When mastered, hold past the cast time to charge a longer, harder-hitting chain that arcs through more targets. Requires Thunder mastered to learn.
elitetensura.skill.stillness.description: Meditation perfected. Serenity regenerates aura, magicules and spiritual health at twice the rate; Inner Calm instantly restores a portion of your maximum pools on a long cooldown.
Inner Calm — your energies surge back.
elitetensura.skill.unbreakable.descripti: Iron Resolve tempered into something unbreakable. Vein Sense, a 50% Iron Aegis, Strength IV Surge — and Undying Will cheats death itself once every cooldown.
elitetensura.skill.unbreakable.undying_w: Undying Will armed — a fatal blow will not end you.
elitetensura.skill.upgrade: Through %1$s's evolution to %2$s, the previous version has been removed.
elitetensura.skill.void_walker.descripti: A unique skill born from existing between dimensions. The user has been touched by Noir's influence, beginning to phase in and out of reality at will.
elitetensura.skill.voidedge.description: A unique skill born from an instinctive grasp over void energy. The power feels raw and incomplete — as though it yearns to become something greater.
elitetensura.skill.voidedge.lack_aura.cl: Void Cloak has faded — insufficient aura to sustain it.
elitetensura.skill.voidsovereign.descrip: An ultimate skill granting absolute dominion over existence, space, and life-force. Those who wield it become sovereign over the void itself.
elitetensura.void_edge.hint: Sneak + Right-Click to cycle · Right-Click to activate
elitetensura.void_edge.no_target: No target in the void's reach.
enchantment.elitetensura.berserkers_bran: +30% melee damage while below half health, but you always take +25% damage while it is in hand.
enchantment.elitetensura.blood_pact.desc: +20% melee damage, but every landed hit costs you 2 HP. It cannot kill you — it always leaves half a heart.
enchantment.elitetensura.iron_maiden.des: +4 armor and +3 armor toughness, but −15% movement speed.
enchantment.elitetensura.mana_thirst.des: +20% melee damage while each hit can drain 250 magicule; when you cannot pay, the blade turns: −20% melee damage.
enchantment.elitetensura.parasite_skin.d: +10 max health and +50% magicule regeneration, but all healing you receive is reduced by 75%.
enchantment.elitetensura.thorn_pact.desc: Reflects 15% of melee damage taken back to the attacker, but you take +10% damage from all sources.
